items.picture: Emma and Lucia's dorm room, empty and tidy: the two beds, the desks with a laptop and a lamp, a shelf of books on the wall, the tall wardrobe, curtains at the window.
The shared dorm kitchen with nobody in it: a stove with a kettle on it, a fridge, a sink, a microwave and a washing machine under the counter, curtains at the window.
The small dorm bathroom: a shower, a sink with two toothbrushes in a mug, towels on hooks. Emma, in a bathrobe, brushes her teeth.
Emma and Lucia on the dormitory's narrow balcony, leaning on the railing with mugs, the city spread out below.

items.text: Kde je kuchyňa? = Where is the kitchen?
items.picture: Emma, new in the dormitory and holding an empty mug, looks around a long corridor full of identical doors, puzzled.
The dormitory staircase: Lucia leans over the railing upstairs and waves; Emma looks up at her from the bottom of the stairs.
Emma comes in through the dormitory entrance with her backpack and stops at the porter's window, where pán Kováč sits behind the glass. A blank notice is pinned to the door.

items.text: Bývam na internáte. = I live in the dorm.
items.picture: Outside the dormitory, a tall concrete student block with rows of windows. Emma walks towards the entrance with her tote bag; Lucia waves from a window.

items.text: Lucia wants to cook. Where does she go?

items.picture: Two halves. Left: a huge elephant. Right: a tiny garden gnome.
Two halves. Left: a dusty old bottle lying on its side, its label peeling. Right: a shiny new bottle, gleaming.

items.text: malý, ale pekný = small but nice

items.picture: Emma flops onto her bed in the dorm room with a happy sigh, her tote bag dropped on the floor.
Emma's desk under the dorm window: a laptop, a pile of books, a mug of tea. Emma sits there writing in a notebook.
Moving-in day in the dorm room: Emma opens the tall wardrobe to check whether it's hers, while Lucia unpacks a pillow onto her bed.
Evening in the dorm room: Lucia switches on the lamp on her desk, a warm circle of light on her books.
Emma throws the dorm room window wide open and leans out into a sunny morning.

items.text: vľavo – vpravo = on the left – on the right
items.picture: Emma and Lucia's dorm room seen from the door, with nobody in it: the desks on the left, the beds on the right, the tall wardrobe at the back.

items.text: vpredu – vzadu = at the front – at the back
items.picture: In the dorm room, Lucia sits at her desk at the front, by the door; Emma sits at hers at the back, under the window. Each is busy with her own work.
Marek proudly shows Emma, Lucia and Tomáš into his new flat, gesturing around the hallway; they look about, impressed.
Marek, in his red flannel shirt, opens the door of his new flat to Emma and Lucia and steps aside with a welcoming sweep of his arm.

items.text: Marek opens the door for Emma and Lucia. What does he say?

items.picture: The narrow hallway of Marek's flat: coat hooks and a shoe rack. Emma and Lucia hang up their jackets.
Marek's living room: a sofa, a rug, a TV and a big window. Lucia drops onto the sofa while Marek carries in a box.
Marek's small bedroom: a double bed, a wardrobe, his chef's jacket hanging on the door.

items.text: V strede je chodba. = The hallway is in the middle.
items.picture: Marek's flat seen from above with the roof lifted off: the hallway in the middle, with the kitchen, bathroom, living room and bedroom around it. Marek, Emma and Lucia stand in the hallway.

Two halves. Left: in a jeweller's, Marek stares wide-eyed at a gold ring with a big sparkling stone, a thick stack of banknotes beside it. Right: at a market stall, Lucia happily tries on a cheap little ring that costs a single coin.
Two halves. Left: Marek's living room, bright with sunlight from a big window. Right: his bedroom, dim, its small window facing a narrow courtyard.

items.text: Lucia asks: “Ktorá lampa je tvoja?” Emma's lamp is on the left. What does Emma say?
items.picture: Moving-in day in the dorm room: Lucia, a box in her arms, asks which lamp is Emma's; Emma points to the one on the left.
